lines.zh: 燃烧平原上，我踩着火走
lines.en: On the burning plains I walk over fire

lines.zh: 六条腿，硬壳，走起来像石块在滚
lines.en: Six legs and hard shell, moving like rolling stone
The ground under me glows red

lines.zh: 火焰从我旁边过去，我不躲
lines.en: Flames pass beside me and I do not flinch
I grind forward step by step

lines.zh: 我的甲在热里变得更硬
lines.en: My shell hardens in the heat
Where I pass, the fire is stamped out
The wind of the burning plains is scalding

lines.zh: 头上的角，在火光里发暗
lines.en: My horn glows dark in the firelight

lines.zh: 我抬头，烟把太阳挡住了
lines.en: I look up, smoke hides the sun
Embers land on my back
I walk along the edge of the lava

lines.zh: 火在我脚下分开，又合上
lines.en: The fire parts under my feet and closes again

lines.zh: 我的腿一节一节，很有力
lines.en: My legs are segmented and strong

lines.zh: 灰太厚，我每一步都踩实
lines.en: The ash is deep, I plant every step
I stand in the fire without moving
This shell does not burn
I lower my head and let the wind pass

lines.zh: 火焰舔着我的腿，我不在意
lines.en: Flames lick my legs, I do not care

lines.zh: 燃烧平原上没什么能吃的
lines.en: There is little to eat on the burning plains

lines.zh: 我的甲上有裂纹，是旧的
lines.en: There are cracks in my shell, old ones

lines.zh: 我把角在石头上磨了磨
lines.en: I grind my horn on a stone
I know this stretch of fire

lines.zh: 我听见有东西在灰里爬
lines.en: I hear something crawling in the ash

lines.zh: 我不动，火星也不敢靠近
lines.en: I stay still and even embers keep away
My shadow writhes in the fire
When the wind turns, the fire changes course
Standing by the fire, you are bold
I lift my head, horn toward you
Your armor is thinner than mine

lines.zh: 你能在这里站着，不简单
lines.en: Standing here at all is no small thing
My shell is six points thick
You do not fear heat, and neither do I
I shift one step your way
Your shadow looks strange on the fire

lines.zh: 我不叫，火的声音够大了
lines.en: I do not call out, the fire is loud enough

lines.zh: 你手里那根东西，会疼吗
lines.en: Will that thing in your hand hurt
A piece of my shell has been knocked away
I step back and the fire parts
That landed on a joint
I grunt, muffled
The shell is thick, and it hurts
I lower my head, shell outward

lines.zh: 血在火里一下就不见了
lines.en: The blood vanishes in the fire
That blow had some force
I grit my teeth with fire at my mouth

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，不怕烧吗
lines.en: Does that in your hand not burn

lines.zh: 我闻了闻，什么味儿都没有
lines.en: I sniff, there is no smell at all
I do not eat this, take it off
You hold it up and your hand is sweating
Nothing here but ash and fire
I move closer and the fire follows me
Set it down and I will look
I do not touch things that burn

lines.zh: 你把东西往远处挪一点
lines.en: Move the thing a little farther off
You hit me and you are the one retreating
My shell is harder than stone
I have not shifted one step

lines.zh: 你踩在火上，又踩在我身上
lines.en: You stepped in fire, then on me
That will leave your hand numb

lines.zh: 我挪开半步，火跟着让开
lines.en: I shift half a step and the fire gives way
Do not walk against my shell
Still standing, that is tough of you
I stepped back to let you pass
Bump again and I push back
There are plenty of my kind on the burning plains
Only a hard shell earns that

lines.zh: 我的角，是磨了很多年的
lines.en: This horn took years to grind

lines.zh: 你先在这里站住，再说别的
lines.en: Hold your ground here first, then we talk
It is too hot to bother talking
The fire will part the road for us
I am not much for soothing words

lines.zh: 这一片火，我守了好几年
lines.en: I have held this stretch of fire for years
Do not stand this close to me
I will go patrol over there
I scrape the ash aside with my forelegs
It is hot, I lift it with my horn

lines.zh: 这东西在我甲上敲了一下
lines.en: It struck my shell once
Dropped in the fire, it melted
I pin it under a foot
I do not recognize this at all
I carry it and my mouth burns
It rolled into a crack
Leave it in the ash, it might be useful
You take it, I cannot bend
A shadow moved beyond the fire
I raise my head, horn forward
This stretch is my ground

lines.zh: 你身上的味道和火不一样
lines.en: Your smell is not like the fire's

lines.zh: 我把脚在灰里刨了两下
lines.en: I paw the ash twice

lines.zh: 燃烧平原上很少有人来
lines.en: Few come to the burning plains
Fire is behind me, your road is closed
My shell can turn a blade
You retreat, and I do not hurry
I know this ash well

lines.zh: 你想过去，得从我这里过
lines.en: To pass, you go through me
I turn heavily

lines.zh: 我的甲上有旧疤，不怕再来
lines.en: My shell has old scars, it can take another
I follow you, and the fire follows

lines.zh: 你绕着裂缝走，我直接过去
lines.en: You skirt the cracks, I go straight across

lines.zh: 我的脚步把火踩出一条路
lines.en: My steps stamp a path through the fire

lines.zh: 这里没有水，你躲不掉热
lines.en: No water here, you cannot escape the heat

lines.zh: 你在灰里跑，扬起来的都是灰
lines.en: You run in ash and only raise ash
Further on is a wall of fire
Embers are landing on my shell
My heavy breathing bends the flames

lines.zh: 这一片没有可以攀的高处
lines.en: There is no high ground to climb here
The wind blows the ash toward you

lines.zh: 你在火边跑，路越来越窄
lines.en: You run by the fire, the path narrows

lines.zh: 我的影子在火里拉得很长
lines.en: My shadow stretches long in the fire
The horn comes in and flips you aside
I lower my head and charge, ash flies
My forefoot comes down and stone cracks
That landed on your chest
I push you toward the fire

lines.zh: 我的甲撞在你身上，很闷
lines.en: My shell hits you with a dull sound
You retreat, and fire is behind you
After that, your hands are shaking
I bear down and the ground sinks
Try blocking that again

lines.zh: 燃烧平原上多了一块硬石
lines.en: A hard stone has appeared on the burning plains
The fire parts around me

lines.zh: 地上多了六道深的印子
lines.en: Six deep prints appear in the ground
Slag still clings to my shell
I shake and embers scatter
I will watch this stretch of fire
I lift a foot and the fire under it dies
My horn shows through the smoke

lines.zh: 我落地时，地面震了一下
lines.en: The ground shook when I landed

lines.zh: 火对我没什么用，只是热
lines.en: Fire does little to me, only heat

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下来，甲磕出个坑
lines.en: I fell from a height and dented my shell
Water hit me and my shell cracked

lines.zh: 炸得我六条腿都错了一步
lines.en: The blast made my six legs miss a step

lines.zh: 一支箭在甲上弹开了，只留个印
lines.en: An arrow glanced off, leaving a mark

lines.zh: 那股劲儿穿过甲缝进来了
lines.en: That force came in through a seam
Nothing grows in fire

lines.zh: 雷打在我的角上，一路麻到脚
lines.en: Lightning hit my horn and numbed me to the feet

lines.zh: 这里没有地面，也没有火
lines.en: No ground here, and no fire
